card.fires_on: The position right before a number or amount, after an opening phrase like "In a recent survey," or "According to the CDC,". Also on "about" or "between" just before a quantity.

modes.label: Approximation word
modes.description: Words like about or between that lead into an estimated figure.
modes.example: According to the CDC,<< about>> one million Americans have CFS.

card.writes: It prepares the model to give a number or fraction such as a share, half, or a third.
card.plain: It fires just before a statistic is stated, such as a percent or count from a study.
